name: maggy
title_zh: AI 先替你筛过一遍的工单收件箱
tagline_zh: GitHub/Asana 工单不再按时间排，按你该先理谁排。跑测试前自动补上下文，每天早上一份竞品动态，全在本地跑。
tagline_en: Issues sorted by what matters, not arrival time. TDD gets context auto-filled, competitor brief lands daily—all.
desc_en: Maggy is a local AI engineering command center. AI-prioritized inbox across issue trackers (GitHub Issues/Asana), one-click TDD execute with iCPG context enrichment, daily competitor intelligence briefing.
why_zh: 不是又一个聚合器，而是把「决策优先级」前置：AI 先读完全部工单再排序。
why_en: Not another aggregator—it front-loads decisions. AI reads all issues before ranking, TDD injects relevant context, so you stop.
limit_zh: 只认 GitHub Issues 和 Asana 两类来源；TDD 只覆盖 Python/JS 项目且需本机装好 py…
limit_en: Only GitHub Issues & Asana. TDD for Python/JS with local pytest/jest. Briefs read public RSS only—no logged-in sources.
title_en: AI-prioritized inbox, one-click TDD, daily competitor brief
